answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13225 Country: India Title: as salmoaliqum mufti sahab .can we do kaza in asar? reply me as soon as possible? Question: as salmoaliqum mufti sahab .can we do kaza in asar? reply me as soon as possible? Answer ID: 13225 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 929/869=B/1430) One can perform qadha salah after Asr as well until the sun is close to set: وبعد صلاۃ فجر وصلاۃ عصر ۔۔۔۔ لا یکرہ قضاء فائتۃ ولو وتراً أو سجدۃ تلاوۃ أو صلاۃ جنازۃ ۔۔۔۔ وقال الزیلعي: ھنا المراد بما بعد العصر قبل تغیر الشمس وأما بعد فلا یجوز فیہ القضاء أیضاً (البحر الرائق 1:437 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
